central_boundary.build: Go 1.26 Alpine; CGO_ENABLED=0; go build ./cmd/server/; linux/amd64 + linux/arm64; runtime alpine:3.24

coverage.source_integrity: Both trees untruncated; tree-recomputed change set equals compare (91); non-test blobs fetched by Git blob SHA and re-hashed; go.mod/go.sum/Dockerfile unchanged.

semantic_findings: Claude OAuth: new oauth-include-create-api-key option (default true) only selects the authorize scope string on the existing Anthropic URL; refresh gains a readiness check that is a no-op off darwin.

internal/auth/power_darwin.go runs fixed /usr/bin/pmset -g systemstate with a 2s timeout (darwin build tag only); the central Linux build compiles power_other.go no-op. Same pattern as the approved v8.0.61 SIWC check.

Codex session instructions: opt-in client_metadata marker stores a ≤32KiB baseline per authenticated caller+explicit session ID in the existing KV store (TTL 24h) or a bounded in-memory map; restored text is excluded from upstream request logs; the marker is stripped and outbound frames are validated so it never reaches the provider.
codex_executor_execute.go: large hunk is difflib realignment of the existing executeCompact/Execute bodies; the chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex default already existed at the baseline.

Home: scheduler continuity query and scheduler_context (request/trace/session IDs, model) sent over the existing operator-configured Home Redis command channel; capability read from Home config payload.
Redis usage queue records add base_url, auth_id and selection_id metadata to the existing local queue consumed by Home/Keeper; no credentials added.
Plugin host: synchronous external usage delivery API with panic fusing; response interceptor gets a Kind field.
Antigravity model probe transport forced to HTTP/1.1 without ALPN using the existing proxy settings; fallback hub version/changelist table updated.
Config v8 migration warning ordering, Codex tool-schema uniqueItems stripping, Interactions↔Gemini argument buffering (50MiB cap), models.json entry: no I/O changes.
No new hosts, exec on Linux, env reads, file writes, embeds or linkname.
limitations: Static malicious-code/dependency increment only; no vulnerability/correctness/performance/test assessment.
Native plugins and external Home not newly approved; provenance:false unchanged.
